required.text: Evaluate the Phase 0 architecture spike described in docs/decisions/0001-phase0-foundation.md and docs/simulation_contract.md. Constructors and snapshot validation restrict this milestone to two actors, one OnHit fragment, and one Burning status. The architecture requires profiling before optimization infrastructure; distinguish future crowd-scaling suggestions from actual defects in this scope. Still report real unbounded behavior, performance regressions, validation gaps, and deterministic/persistence errors with a concrete scenario. Verify file paths.
Core must remain independent of Godot. Client presentation, input mapping, and profiling must not independently decide damage, collision, loot, or authoritative time.

Save/replay inputs must preserve valid logical state and reject incompatible content/rules without silently overwriting newer saves. A packaged smoke check must establish actual success rather than relying only on the engine process exit code.
